stops.note: the sea cow of Southeast Asian waters; Malay putri duyung, 'duyung princess', means mermaid
the naturalist Buffon introduced the name to European zoology in his Histoire naturelle
borrowed from Buffon's French; its giant Arctic relative, Steller's sea cow, had already been hunted to extinction by 1768

current_meaning: a plant-eating marine mammal of the Indian and Pacific oceans
